original.target_description: Study 1: unadjusted between-condition ANOVA of actual soup consumption, self-refilling versus normal bowls; main effect at supplied original PDF p. 4 (journal p. 96).

n.sample_role: Participants in the main two-condition consumption test; normal bowls n=23 and self-refilling bowls n=31.
n.exclusions: Not reported in the original paper; no exclusions can be established.
n.location: Journal p. 99, Table 2, all-participants header; Table 1 p. 97 F(1,52)

es.location: Journal p. 96 (PDF p. 4), Results, first ANOVA; Table 1 p. 97 actual ounces row

p.location: Journal p. 96 (PDF p. 4), Results, first ANOVA

replication.target_description: Study 1: main unadjusted between-condition comparison of actual soup consumption, self-refilling versus normal bowls; Table 1 actual ounces/calories rows.

n.sample_role: Participants retained for the main actual-consumption comparison (normal bowls 246; self-refilling bowls 218).
n.exclusions: 190 of 654 excluded: 168 for discovery of the study purpose (whole groups excluded if any member inferred it), and 22 for experimenter error.
n.location: Advance-online p. 2, Participants, final sample; p. 5 Table 2 all-participants header (HTML L397–418, L942–944)

es.test_statistic: F = 23.64 (Table 1; degrees of freedom not printed there)
es.location: Advance-online p. 5, Discussion (HTML L828–830); F in p. 4 Table 1 actual consumption rows

p.location: Advance-online p. 4, Table 1, actual consumption rows, current-study F and triple-asterisk footnote (HTML L753–755, L775)

reported_success.location: Advance-online paper p. 5, Discussion; cached HTML L856
reported_success.quote: We therefore deem this replication successful.

notes: The broad description is mapped to the main unadjusted actual-consumption contrast, not to covariate effects. Original p. 96 also reports adjusted visual-cue tests F(1,49)=4.7 and F(1,50)=10.6; these are distinct models and were not combined with the main-test p. Replication d is printed in Discussion and corresponds to the Table 1 actual-consumption contrast. In the web parse the less-than glyph appears as a comma in p,.001; this denotes p < .001. Reported success is the authors' overall replication verdict, not a separate adjudication of every secondary result.
